description: List the file topics in a course's Content area that the student has not saved yet, by comparing topic ids with what download_file (when it saved to disk) and download_course_files saved. Use this whenever the user asks what is new, what they are missing, or to pull or sync a course. It checks the Content area only: This covers the Content area only, not the whole course. It did not look at: the student's own assignment submissions and instructor feedback (get_assignments, then download_file with folderId and fileId); assignment attachments (get_assignment_files); announcement attachments (get_announcement_files); the syllabus (get_syllabus). An empty unsaved list does not mean the whole course is saved. It reads the course's current table of contents fresh, so it also finds a file that was uploaded long ago and only released now. IMPORTANT: unsaved means the server has no record of saving it. A file the student already has from before this version, or saved another way (browser download, manual copy), appears as unsaved, so ask the user before downloading everything again; for files they already have, use mark_course_files_saved to record them without downloading (ask first, and never mark files as saved just to shorten this list). A listed topic may not be open yet (locked, hidden or outside its release dates); download_file explains why when it can. A saved file that has since been deleted is listed in savedFileMissing and needs downloading again. markedSavedCount counts topics the student marked saved: the server never checked a file for them. Each listed topic has downloadArgs for download_file, plus its title and lastModified when known; ask the user where to save before downloading, and never guess a folder. If complete is false, or there is a notice, something could not be read: say so, and never tell the user there is nothing new. syncFolder is read for this call only (it is not remembered): pass it again on every call. To find what is new or missing from the student's saved files ("pull from Brightspace", "what don't I have yet"), call get_unsaved_course_files: it compares the course's content topics by topic id with what download_file and download_course_files saved, then download each listed topic with download_file (topicId). Never conclude a file is absent or not new from get_course_content's modifiedSince: an instructor can upload a file weeks before releasing it, and releasing it does not change its lastModified.

courseId.description: Course ID to compare against what has been saved.

moduleId.description: Only compare this module and the modules inside it. Use a module id from get_course_content.

syncFolder.description: Absolute path of a folder the student ran download_course_files (or the sync command) into, that the server has not synced into itself: only that folder's .brightspace-sync.json is read, for this call only. It is not remembered, so pass it again on every call. It must exist. Not needed for files saved with download_file, or for folders the server synced into itself.

name: get_unsaved_course_files
title: Get Unsaved Course Files
